description: A new player joins, gets oak logs, crafts oak planks after /recipe took the recipe, fills ten slots, stands in water, cuts a cobblestone slab whose recipe was taken, sees a recipe, changes the books' settings, is given recipes (map extending, a known one, every one) and has one taken and given, joins again and has every recipe taken: per step the recipe-book packets (ids sorted within each and the packets sorted), each recipe's full entry, and the replies; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
